go:github.com/riducms/ridu#New.summary: Create an application from config and a document store.
details: When compiled by ridu build, the application carries the exact ordered migration-history fingerprint used by official adapter readiness. Application-owned servers remain responsible for running readiness before admitting traffic.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu#Resolve.summary: Resolve executable config into a deterministic schema manifest.
details: Resolution runs plugin transforms without opening a database.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu#Execute.summary: Run the API, admin, jobs, and shutdown lifecycle.

parameters.name: applicationConfig
parameters.description: Executable collections, globals, plugins, tasks, and application policy.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Runtime infrastructure and framework-owned server settings.

returns.description: The first joined project-command, startup, serving, drain, or cleanup failure.

details: With project-command arguments, Execute resolves config and runs the versioned CLI protocol without applying runtime options or opening adapters. With no arguments, it starts the framework-owned HTTP server and requires WithStore.

Server startup opens the document store, opens optional upload storage, constructs the application, verifies readiness, binds the listener, and only then starts background workers. SIGINT or SIGTERM marks readiness as draining, shuts down HTTP work, drains workers, and closes lifecycle-owned adapters.
Execute blocks until the command or server lifecycle finishes. Return its error from main or log it as a fatal startup/runtime failure.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu#Where.summary: Constrain access to documents matching a query expression.
details: Use filtered decisions only for operations with an atomic document predicate. Creates, globals, and admin entry accept Allow or Deny.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu#AccessDecisio.summary: An allow, deny, or atomic document-filter decision.

parameters.name: Where
parameters.description: Require a predicate on the atomic store operation.

parameters.name: Filter
parameters.description: Return a detached predicate for a filtered decision.

details: AccessDecision is immutable. Construct it with Allow, Deny, or Where; filtered predicates remain attached to the same atomic store query as the operation.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu#AccessRule.summary: Authorize one operation with actor and transaction context.

returns.description: Allow, deny, or atomically filter the operation.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu#AccessContext.summary: Actor, target, locale, data, and nested API supplied to an access rule.

parameters.name: ID
parameters.description: Current document ID; empty for create and list.

parameters.name: ActorCollection
parameters.description: The exact auth collection that owns Actor.

parameters.name: Local
parameters.description: Nested operations in the active transaction.

details: Use the root alias in application configuration.

parameters.name: Admin

parameters.name: ReadVersions

parameters.name: Publish

parameters.name: Unpublish

parameters.name: Unlock

go:github.com/riducms/ridu#GlobalAccess.summary: Allow-or-deny rules for global reads, versions, and updates.

parameters.name: Publish

parameters.name: Unpublish

parameters.name: Name

parameters.name: NameTranslations

parameters.name: Localization

parameters.name: AllowIDOnCreate

parameters.name: Globals

parameters.name: Endpoints

parameters.name: Tasks

parameters.name: AfterCommit

parameters.name: Storage

go:github.com/riducms/ridu#Hook.summary: Run code during a collection or global lifecycle phase.

parameters.name: ctx
parameters.description: The operation, user, values, and local API for this phase. Change Data entries before saving or Document.Values to change the response.

returns.description: Before commit, an error fails and rolls back the operation. AfterCommit errors report a committed failure.

details: Return nil to continue or an error to stop. A pre-commit error rolls back the operation; an AfterCommit error cannot undo saved data.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu#AfterCommitDi.summary: Choose how hooks run after their transaction commits.

parameters.name: Dispatch
parameters.description: Deliver one effect after its transaction commits.

returns.description: A delivery error that cannot roll back committed content.

details: Without a custom dispatcher, AfterCommit hooks run synchronously. A dispatcher must call effect.Run or arrange for it to run; a Go callback is not itself a durable task.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu#AfterCommitEf.summary: The operation details and callback passed to an after-commit dispatcher.

parameters.name: DocumentID
parameters.description: The document ID, or an empty string when the operation has no single document, such as a list read.

parameters.name: Run
parameters.description: Run the original hook outside its committed transaction using the supplied execution context.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu#LocalizationC.summary: Content locales, fallback behavior, and optional request-scoped admin availability.

parameters.name: DefaultLocale
parameters.description: Locale selected when a request does not specify one.

parameters.name: DisableFallback
parameters.description: Requires exact locale values instead of following fallback chains.

parameters.name: AvailableLocales
parameters.description: Optionally reduces locales visible to one admin request without weakening API validation or authorization.

details: Leave Locales empty to disable content localization. When localization is enabled, DefaultLocale must name one configured locale and every fallback must also be configured.

FallbackLocales are checked in order after the requested locale unless DisableFallback is true. AvailableLocales only narrows the locale picker for the current admin request; it cannot add locales, change API validation, or grant access, and executable callbacks are never serialized into the schema manifest.
Assign this value to Config.Localization. Because the root package aliases the canonical core contract, an AvailableLocales callback names its input as core.LocaleAvailabilityContext.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu#Locale.summary: One content locale and its ordered fallback chain.

parameters.name: Code
parameters.description: Stable locale code used by APIs and storage.

parameters.name: FallbackLocales
parameters.description: Configured locale codes checked in order when this locale has no value.

details: Code is the stable wire and storage identity; changing it is a data migration. Label and RTL affect authoring presentation. Fallback chains must be acyclic and may name only configured locales.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu#CollectionAdm.summary: Serializable collection presentation and editorial organization.

parameters.name: UseAsTitle
parameters.description: Field path used as the document’s author-facing title.

parameters.name: DefaultColumns
parameters.description: Initial field paths shown in the collection list.

parameters.name: FolderField
parameters.description: Field path used for folder organization.

parameters.name: ParentField
parameters.description: Field path used for hierarchical parent relationships.

details: Presentation never grants access. FolderField and ParentField configure hierarchy metadata; LivePreview is an implemented authoring preview surface.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu#LivePreviewCo.summary: A frontend URL template and named authoring viewports.

parameters.name: Breakpoints
parameters.description: Named authoring viewports offered by the editor.

details: URL may contain {id}, {collection}, and {field:path.to.value} placeholders. Preview tokens are short-lived, read-only, and scoped to one resource.

parameters.name: SessionDuration
parameters.description: Session lifetime; zero defaults to 24 hours.

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description: Controls local password validation and hashing.

parameters.name: MaxLoginAttempts
parameters.description: Failures before lockout; zero defaults to 5 and a negative value disables lockout.

parameters.name: LockDuration
parameters.description: Lockout duration; zero defaults to 10 minutes.

parameters.name: PasswordReset
parameters.description: Enables recovery when its Send callback is configured.

parameters.name: Verify
parameters.description: Requires verified email before local login when non-nil.

parameters.name: Hooks
parameters.description: Observes or rejects authentication lifecycle phases.

parameters.name: Strategies
parameters.description: Adds application-owned request authentication in declaration order.

details: Local password auth is built in. Recovery/email flows require trusted Send callbacks. External strategies are compiled Go integrations, not dynamically loaded providers. Private hashes and tokens never enter content fields or hooks.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu#UploadConfig.summary: Validation, privacy, and image-variant policy for an upload collection.

parameters.name: MaxFileSize
parameters.description: Accepted byte limit; zero uses the framework default and values above 256 MiB are rejected.

parameters.name: MimeTypes
parameters.description: Allowed media types; empty accepts any supported type.

parameters.name: Private
parameters.description: Requires authorized delivery instead of public object URLs.

parameters.name: ImageSizes
parameters.description: Derived variants generated for supported image uploads.

details: Upload collections also require Config.Storage, a stable StorageNamespace, and a store implementing UploadObjectLocker. Image variants are generated only for supported images.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu#VersionConfig.summary: Drafts, snapshot retention, and autosave policy.

parameters.name: MaxPerDocument
parameters.description: Limits retained revisions; zero uses the framework default.

parameters.name: AutosaveInterval
parameters.description: Controls draft autosave frequency; zero resolves to the 30-second framework default.

details: Versions must be enabled on the collection/global. MaxPerDocument zero resolves to 100. AutosaveInterval zero currently resolves to 30 seconds, and a configured interval must be at least one second; it drives admin update calls rather than a server-side mutation timer. Optimistic revision checks are available through MutationOptions.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu#HandlerOption.summary: HTTP security, size bounds, observers, and trusted-proxy policy.

parameters.name: AdminAssets
parameters.description: Overrides the framework’s embedded admin asset filesystem.

parameters.name: MaxBodyBytes
parameters.description: Limits decoded request bodies; zero uses the framework default.

parameters.name: SecureCookies
parameters.description: Restricts authentication cookies to HTTPS requests.

parameters.name: AllowedOrigins
parameters.description: Lists browser origins permitted by credentialed CORS.

parameters.name: AllowedRequestHeaders
parameters.description: Appends application-owned CORS request headers; invalid HTTP token names are ignored.

parameters.name: AllowedHosts
parameters.description: Restricts Host to exact hostnames with optional ports; empty accepts syntactically valid development hosts.

parameters.name: TrustedProxyCIDRs
parameters.description: Lists proxies whose forwarded client addresses may be trusted.

parameters.name: AuthRateLimit
parameters.description: Sets maximum auth attempts per identity and client window.

parameters.name: Observe
parameters.description: Receives timing and status metadata for completed requests.

parameters.name: RequestError
parameters.description: Receives trusted diagnostic detail while public responses remain redacted.

parameters.name: RequestTimeout
parameters.description: Limits request execution; zero uses the default and a negative value disables the bound.

parameters.name: ReadinessTimeout
parameters.description: Bounds the complete readiness probe; zero uses five seconds and a negative value disables it.

parameters.name: DisableContentSecurityPolicy
parameters.description: Disables CSP when an upstream gateway owns it.

parameters.name: StrictTransportSecurity
parameters.description: Emits the configured HSTS value when every public request is HTTPS.

parameters.name: TaskBatch
parameters.description: Limits leases claimed during one polling cycle.

parameters.name: TaskQueues
parameters.description: Restricts this process to named worker queues; empty consumes every queue.

parameters.name: TaskLeaseDuration
parameters.description: Sets the lease extended while a handler runs.

parameters.name: TaskHeartbeatInterval
parameters.description: Sets heartbeat cadence and must be shorter than the lease.

parameters.name: TaskPruneBatch
parameters.description: Bounds expired terminal task records removed per cycle.

parameters.name: AuthPruneBatch
parameters.description: Bounds expired sessions and API keys removed per maintenance cycle.

parameters.name: JobError
parameters.description: Receives failures from scheduled background work.

details: Pass this value to App.Handler when embedding Ridu, or install it with WithHandlerOptions when Execute owns the server.

The zero value is development-friendly. Before production, set SecureCookies and AllowedHosts, add AllowedOrigins only for cross-origin browser clients, and trust only proxy ranges you operate. Body, request, readiness, worker, and maintenance bounds resolve independently when left at zero.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu#WithStore.summary: Provide the singular document-store adapter through the Execute lifecycle.

parameters.name: factory
parameters.description: A lazy constructor invoked once when Execute starts the HTTP server.

returns.description: An option to pass directly to ridu.Execute.

details: WithStore is required only for the no-argument server branch of Execute. Project commands such as generate and check resolve config without applying this option, so they do not need DATABASE_URL or a reachable database.
The factory receives the server lifecycle context. Return an unopened error rather than terminating the process inside the factory; Execute wraps it as open document store and returns it to main.

The returned store must implement the base store.Store contract and every optional capability enabled by the application. Production startup also requires store.ReadinessStore unless ServerOptions.AllowUnverifiableReadiness delegates readiness checking to an external system.

Execute owns the returned adapter. On startup failure or shutdown it calls Close() or Close() error when implemented, bounded by ServerOptions.ShutdownTimeout. Optional upload storage closes first, then the document store.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu#WithProjectMi.summary: Register the selected adapter’s compiled migration driver for project commands.

parameters.name: driver
parameters.description: Compiled callback registry and adapter-owned project migration runner.

returns.description: An option to pass directly to ridu.Execute.

details: The driver is used only by project migration commands whose artifacts contain compiled data callbacks. It is not used by schema generation or the ordinary HTTP runtime.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu#WithAddress.summary: Configure the HTTP listen address independently from the store adapter.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: A Go net.Listen TCP address such as :8080 or 127.0.0.1:8080.

returns.description: An option to pass directly to ridu.Execute.

details: The default is :8080, which listens on every interface. Use a loopback address when Ridu must be reachable only through a local reverse proxy or during development.
This controls only the listener. Public host validation belongs to HandlerOptions.AllowedHosts.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu#WithUploadSto.summary: Provide object storage through the Execute lifecycle.

parameters.name: factory
parameters.description: A lazy object-storage constructor invoked during server startup.

returns.description: An option to pass directly to ridu.Execute.

details: The factory runs only in the server branch. It supplies Config.Storage before application construction, keeping credentials and network setup out of the resolved schema manifest.
Upload-enabled config still needs a stable Config.StorageNamespace and a document store with the upload capability contracts. Closable object storage shuts down before the document store.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu#WithHandlerOp.summary: Configure the generated HTTP handler used by Execute.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: HTTP security, limits, admin assets, observers, readiness, and worker settings.

returns.description: An option to pass directly to ridu.Execute.

details: Generated projects use this option to attach the compiled admin assets and environment-derived HTTP policy. Passing it replaces the complete HandlerOptions value; combine settings in one value rather than scattering repeated WithHandlerOptions calls.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu#WithServerOpt.summary: Configure production socket and graceful-drain bounds.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Socket, readiness admission, shutdown, and worker-drain settings.

returns.description: An option to pass directly to ridu.Execute.

details: Zero values select bounded production defaults. Repeating WithServerOptions replaces the complete value, so configure related bounds together.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu#NewTask.summary: Define a compiled typed durable task.
details: Add the returned definition to Config.Tasks. Input and output use strict JSON contracts, are capped by MaxTaskPayloadBytes, and never select executable code from serialized data. The backing store must implement store.TaskStore.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu#TypedTask.summary: A registered typed handle for durable admission, status, and cancellation.

parameters.name: TaskSlug
parameters.description: Returns the stable registered task slug.

parameters.name: Enqueue
parameters.description: Validates and durably admits typed input.

parameters.name: Result
parameters.description: Loads and decodes typed task status and output.

parameters.name: Cancel
parameters.description: Prevents queued work and fences a running attempt.

details: Only NewTask constructs a valid definition. Add it to Config.Tasks before using its runtime methods.
The handle slug/type contract must match the definition registered in the running application. HasOutput distinguishes a valid zero/null output from incomplete work.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu#TaskQueue.summary: Select the queue used by a typed task.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu#TaskRetries.summary: Persist retry count, delay, maximum delay, and backoff policy.
details: Persisted policy prevents deployments from silently changing already-admitted work.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu#TaskRetention.summary: Keep terminal task status/output for a bounded duration.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu#TaskAdmission.summary: Repair durable domain records that missed task admission.
details: The runtime invokes this bounded, idempotent callback before each selected claim cycle, including startup.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu#RetryTask.summary: Return a retryable handler failure using configured backoff.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu#RetryTaskAfte.summary: Return a retryable handler failure with an explicit delay.

details: Use stable non-secret codes. Local runtime, store, and codec boundary failures use structured TaskError values. Handler panics and handler/output failures are classified into durable retry or dead-letter state instead.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu#App.summary: A resolved application bound to its document and optional service stores.

parameters.name: Handler
parameters.description: Build the REST API, admin, plugin routes, health, and readiness handler.

details: App owns initialized runtime services; its fields are intentionally private. Construct it with New, or let Execute own the ordinary production lifecycle.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu#AdminConfig.summary: Select the auth collection trusted to enter the framework admin.

parameters.name: User
parameters.description: The auth-enabled collection whose sessions may enter the admin; required when any auth collection exists.

parameters.name: Localization
parameters.description: Configures interface languages and editor timezones independently from content localization.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu#AdminLocaliza.summary: Configure admin interface languages and editor timezone choices.

parameters.name: Languages

parameters.name: DefaultLanguage
parameters.description: Language selected when no valid preference exists.

parameters.name: DefaultTimeZone
parameters.description: Timezone selected when no valid preference exists.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu#AdminLanguage.summary: One statically bundled admin interface language.

parameters.name: RTL
parameters.description: Whether the whole interface uses right-to-left layout.

parameters.name: ID
parameters.description: Browser-safe IANA timezone, UTC, or fixed offset.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu#CollectionLab.summary: Singular and plural author-facing collection labels.

parameters.name: Singular
parameters.description: The label used when referring to one document.

parameters.name: Plural
parameters.description: The label used in navigation and collection lists.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu#CollectionInd.summary: One ordered compound index; Unique enforces tuple uniqueness.

parameters.name: Fields
parameters.description: Dot-separated authored paths in index order; paths may traverse non-repeated groups.

parameters.name: Unique
parameters.description: Enforces tuple uniqueness while still allowing multiple rows containing null.

details: Compound paths traverse non-repeated groups. Unique indexes permit multiple rows containing null.

parameters.name: Group
parameters.description: Places the global under an author-facing navigation group.

parameters.name: LivePreview
parameters.description: Configures the editor preview URL and viewports.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu#DocumentLockC.summary: Expiration policy for coordinated authoring locks.

parameters.name: Duration
parameters.description: Controls how long an untouched persisted lock remains active.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu#PasswordPolic.summary: Length, byte, bcrypt, and common-password policy for local credentials.

parameters.name: MinLength
parameters.description: Minimum Unicode code-point length; zero defaults to 8.

parameters.name: MaxBytes
parameters.description: Maximum UTF-8 byte length; zero defaults to bcrypt’s safe 72-byte limit.

parameters.name: BcryptCost
parameters.description: bcrypt work factor; zero uses bcrypt.DefaultCost and values above 16 are rejected.

parameters.name: Validate
parameters.description: Adds an application-specific rule and should return a user-safe correction message.

details: Ridu deliberately uses length-based defaults rather than mandatory character classes. The custom validator runs only in trusted Go code and is never serialized.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu#PasswordReset.summary: Token lifetime and trusted notification callback for password recovery.

parameters.name: TokenDuration

parameters.name: Send

go:github.com/riducms/ridu#VerifyEmailCo.summary: Token lifetime and trusted notification callback for email verification.

parameters.name: TokenDuration

parameters.name: Send
parameters.description: Delivers the newly issued verification token.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu#AuthAccess.summary: Rules for login, sessions, recovery, API keys, and external authentication.

parameters.name: Session
parameters.description: Controls session listing and revocation operations.

details: A nil rule allows its operation. These rules complement collection CRUD access; they do not replace it.

parameters.name: User

parameters.name: IPAddress

parameters.name: AfterLogin

parameters.description: After Forgot Password callbacks in declaration order.

parameters.description: After Password Reset callbacks in declaration order.

parameters.description: After Verification callbacks in declaration order.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu#AuthIdentity.summary: An exact auth collection plus actor document.

parameters.name: Field

credential recreation because bcrypt salts make each incarnation unique.

without revoking otherwise-valid sessions. The exact-hash compare-and-set
prevents a slow bcrypt upgrade from overwriting a concurrent reset.

StepMongoDBCreateIndex creates one planner-owned MongoDB index outside a database transaction. The payload freezes physical identity only; the adapter must reconstruct and exactly match the definition from the embedded manifest and versioned planner before touching a database.

StepMongoDBDropIndex removes one planner-owned MongoDB index outside a database transaction. The adapter reconstructs the exact physical collection and index definition from the embedded manifests; the payload never carries an arbitrary command.

StepMongoDBDropResources removes the content and version namespaces for one exact, sorted set of reviewed retired stable identities. Framework-owned shared state is removed by the preceding transactional retirement step.

StepMongoDBRenameResource moves one collection identity to another outside a database transaction. Only stable manifest identities are persisted; the MongoDB adapter derives the exact content and version namespaces.
StepPluginSQL executes one checksum-protected plugin migration.
StepRenameContent rewrites schema-addressed content after physical renames.

StepRetireResources removes framework-owned shared state for resources that a reviewed destructive migration removes. It is a typed semantic executor and must run before the corresponding physical tables are dropped.

ts:@riducms/plugin#AdminPlugin.summary: A Go plugin’s exported collection of admin field editors, pages, and other components.

parameters.name: apiVersion
parameters.description: Added by `defineAdminPlugin` from the versioned import. Do not set this yourself.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Required. Match the Go plugin’s Key(), for example color or editorial-tools. Use a lowercase key with hyphens between words.

parameters.name: pairingVersion
parameters.description: Required positive integer. Match `Admin.PairingVersion` in the Go descriptor. Increase it when an older Go or admin package would no longer work with the other.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.type: Readonly<Record<string, RegisteredPluginField & { readonly type: "plugin"; readonly fieldType?: never; }>>
parameters.description: Optional. Map Go field-type keys to `definePluginField` results. These become the default editors for those new field types; the keys match `PluginFieldType.Key` in Go.

parameters.name: components
parameters.type: Readonly<Record<string, RegisteredPluginField & ({ readonly type: Exclude<FieldType, "plugin">; } | { readonly type: "plugin"; readonly fieldType: string; })>>
parameters.description: Optional. Map component names to `defineFieldComponent` results. Go chooses an alternative editor with `field.PluginComponent(pluginKey, componentName)`.

parameters.name: rowLabels
parameters.description: Optional. Row headings made with `defineRowLabelPlugin`. Go selects them with `field.PluginComponent` in `Admin.RowLabel`.

parameters.name: messages
parameters.description: Optional. Translations bundled with the plugin, created with `defineAdminMessages`.

parameters.name: assets
parameters.description: Optional. Package-relative modules or styles imported during the admin build. Keep the list and order identical to `Admin.Assets` in the Go descriptor.

parameters.name: routes
parameters.description: Optional. Add pages inside the admin, each with a relative path, component, and optional navigation link. Plugin routes must also appear in the Go descriptor.

parameters.name: dashboard
parameters.description: Optional. Add panels before or after the dashboard, or replace it. Each entry names a key, component, and position; the default position is after.

parameters.name: login
parameters.description: Optional. Add content before or after sign-in, or replace the screen. A replacement can render `defaultView` to retain the login form.

parameters.name: account
parameters.description: Optional. Add content to or replace the profile or security screen, selected by surface.

parameters.name: navigation
parameters.description: Optional. Add content around the navigation links or replace navigation. Use routes for a new page with its own navigation link.

parameters.name: logoutButton
parameters.description: Optional. Replace the account menu’s sign-out control. The component receives `host.logout()` to end the session.

parameters.name: views
parameters.description: Optional. Wrap or replace collection lists, create/edit forms, global editors, or the not-found page. The component can render `defaultView` to keep the built-in screen.

parameters.name: branding
parameters.description: Optional. Replace the login logo, navigation logo, or account avatar. Each location accepts one replacement.

parameters.name: shell
parameters.description: Optional. Add a component to the header, global actions, or account settings menu.

parameters.name: providers
parameters.description: Optional. Share context between components by wrapping the admin. The first provider is outermost; every provider must render `defaultView`.

parameters.name: listCells
parameters.description: Optional. Change how a field appears in a collection table. Each entry selects a collection, field path, and component.

parameters.name: documentActions
parameters.description: Optional. Add buttons to saved collection documents. A component implements the action; an optional requires permission hides it when the user lacks that permission.

parameters.name: documentViews
parameters.description: Optional. Add tabs beside Edit and API on saved documents or globals. Each entry includes a key, label, and component; collection can limit where it appears.

details: Use the linked registration helper to create this value. Component arrays keep their order; installed plugin entries come before application entries. Each replacement location accepts one component.

ts:@riducms/cli/run#runRidu.summary: Download or reuse the matching native Ridu binary, run it with inherited stdio, and resolve its exit code.

parameters.name: arguments_
parameters.description: CLI arguments passed to the native Ridu executable.

returns.description: The native process exit code, using 1 when the process exits without a code.

details: The launcher forwards SIGINT and SIGTERM while the child is running and inherits the parent process standard streams.
ts:@riducms/cli/run#runRidu.example:
import { runRidu } from '@riducms/cli/run';

process.exitCode = await runRidu(['doctor']);

cli:ridu#ridu new.summary: Scaffold a thin Ridu application, resolve Go dependencies, and generate its first contracts.

parameters.name: --template
parameters.description: Embedded application template; defaults to starter.

parameters.name: --database
parameters.description: Official database adapter; defaults to postgres.

parameters.name: --package-manager
parameters.description: Frontend package manager; defaults to npm outside the interactive wizard.

parameters.name: --agent
parameters.description: Release-matched local coding-agent layout; defaults to codex outside a terminal.

parameters.name: --no-agent
parameters.description: Do not install coding-agent entrypoints, skills, or ownership manifest.

parameters.name: --module
parameters.description: Go module path; defaults to example.com/<project>.

parameters.name: --scope
parameters.description: npm scope for the generated admin workspace; defaults to @<project>.

parameters.name: directory
parameters.description: New project directory, which must not already exist.

details: The scaffold is kept if dependency setup or initial generation fails, and the CLI prints recovery commands.
--release-version is a framework-development override for exercising an alternate dependency release; ordinary application authors should not use it.
cli:ridu#ridu new.example:
ridu new --package-manager npm \
	--module github.com/acme/content \
	--scope @acme \
	content
cd content
npm install
npm run dev

cli:ridu#ridu agent install.summary: Install a release-matched local agent layout into an existing Ridu project.
details: Installs both ridu-project and payload-to-ridu with their offline references. Existing AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md instructions are preserved, and unmanaged skill files are never replaced.
.ridu-agent-docs.json records only framework-owned files, digests, selected layouts, and the framework release.

cli:ridu#ridu agent sync.summary: Synchronize installed framework-owned skill references with the current CLI release.
details: Sync validates every recorded digest before writing and stops if a managed file contains local edits. Root project instructions are never synchronized.

cli:ridu#ridu doctor.summary: Diagnose Go, Bun, project discovery, frontend dependencies, and local database prerequisites.
details: Docker or OrbStack is optional when DATABASE_URL is already set for PostgreSQL or MongoDB, and is not required for SQLite projects. doctor validates RIDU_SQLITE_PATH when configured and reports whether frontend dependencies are installed or will be installed by dev/build.

cli:ridu#ridu dev.summary: Run the selected database adapter, generation, safe schema sync, API, admin watch mode, and Go-config watching together.

parameters.name: --database-url
parameters.description: PostgreSQL or MongoDB development URL; defaults to DATABASE_URL, then the selected scaffold Compose service.

parameters.name: --database-path
parameters.description: SQLite-only development path; defaults to RIDU_SQLITE_PATH, then .ridu/development.sqlite.

parameters.name: --address
parameters.description: Go API listen address; defaults to 127.0.0.1:8080.

parameters.name: --no-docker
parameters.description: Do not start the scaffolded PostgreSQL or MongoDB Compose service.

parameters.name: --no-install
parameters.description: Do not install missing frontend dependencies with the configured package manager.

parameters.name: --no-sync
parameters.description: Do not apply a safe non-destructive development schema plan.

details: Automatic sync pauses instead of guessing when a possible rename needs review. Create and apply a migration, then restart dev.
Development injects local-only insecure cookie/database admissions into the child server; those are not production defaults.

cli:ridu#ridu generate.summary: Resolve executable Go config and atomically write every configured generated contract.

parameters.name: --check
parameters.description: Compare expected bytes without writing; exit unsuccessfully on missing or stale output.

details: Generation executes the application’s versioned private manifest command; it never parses Go source and never connects to the database.
Configured outputs include the canonical schema manifest, Go and TypeScript contracts/client module, OpenAPI, and static admin plugin registry.
cli:ridu#ridu generate.example:
ridu generate
git diff -- generated/
ridu generate --check

cli:ridu#ridu check.summary: Run the generated-contract, migration-history, Go, TypeScript, and Svelte project checks.
details: The command checks generation drift, current migration history, gofmt, go vet, go test ./..., then the project Bun check script when an admin is configured. It does not silently regenerate stale contracts.

cli:ridu#ridu build.summary: Regenerate contracts, build the admin, and atomically install one production Go binary.

parameters.name: --output
parameters.description: Binary path; defaults to dist/<project> (with .exe on Windows).

details: Missing frontend dependencies are installed first. The admin assets are compiled before go build -trimpath; the final binary is renamed into place only after a successful build.

cli:ridu#ridu migrate create.summary: Plan and write one reviewable immutable migration artifact without connecting to a database.

parameters.name: --accept-renames
parameters.description: PostgreSQL or MongoDB: accept every unambiguous detected rename without an interactive prompt.

parameters.name: --transform
parameters.description: SQLite or MongoDB: bind a named compiled data transform to the immutable artifact.

parameters.name: --allow-destructive
parameters.description: Record destructive changes confirmed by the selected adapter planner after explicit review.

details: PostgreSQL and MongoDB rename candidates require confirmation or --accept-renames. SQLite rejects --accept-renames and uses --transform instead for stored canonical JSON rewrites. MongoDB transforms run through the compiled project migration driver. Destructive approval does not bypass semantic transitions Ridu cannot safely automate.
cli:ridu#ridu migrate create.example:
ridu migrate create --name rename-post-title
git diff -- migrations/

cli:ridu#ridu migrate plan.summary: Inspect pending immutable execution topology without applying it.
details: PostgreSQL and MongoDB use --database-url or DATABASE_URL and accept --allow-insecure-database only for local development; SQLite uses --database-path or RIDU_SQLITE_PATH. Current executable config must match the latest artifact target before database inspection proceeds. JSON output exposes adapter-owned phase, step, checksum, and state details.

cli:ridu#ridu migrate status.summary: Compare immutable artifact history with the database ledger.
details: PostgreSQL and MongoDB use --database-url or DATABASE_URL; SQLite uses --database-path or RIDU_SQLITE_PATH. Status is read-only and does not accept maintenance, timeout, or stop-boundary flags. MongoDB status validates immutable lineage, checksum-bound durable progress, and exact physical state.

cli:ridu#ridu migrate verify.summary: Replay complete history in an isolated adapter-owned database and validate every intermediate state.
details: PostgreSQL verification uses a temporary shadow schema and accepts runner timeout controls but not stop boundaries. SQLite needs no deployment path and replays history, including registered compiled transforms, in a temporary database. MongoDB uses a command-scoped credential to create, replay, verify, and drop a random shadow database; use separate scoped credentials for the running application, verification, and backups.

cli:ridu#ridu migrate up.summary: Validate complete history and apply pending artifacts under adapter-owned coordination.
details: PostgreSQL requires secure transport unless explicitly admitted, holds a session advisory lock, and resumes durable phased checkpoints. SQLite applies every pending artifact atomically under one BEGIN IMMEDIATE writer reservation. MongoDB requires verified TLS unless explicitly admitted for local development, holds a fenced expiring lease, and resumes checksum-bound durable steps.
cli:ridu#ridu migrate up.example:
DATABASE_URL="$MONGODB_MIGRATION_URL" ridu migrate plan --json
# Drain every old application process, worker, and other writer.
DATABASE_URL="$MONGODB_OPERATIONAL_URL" ridu migrate verify
# Capture the matched database/upload snapshot.
DATABASE_URL="$MONGODB_MIGRATION_URL" ridu migrate up
DATABASE_URL="$MONGODB_MIGRATION_URL" ridu migrate status
# Start only the new digest; require /readyz before admitting traffic.
DATABASE_URL="$MONGODB_APP_URL" ./dist/content

cli:ridu#ridu migrate down.summary: Reverse the latest applied SQLite artifact while retaining its immutable file.
details: SQLite only. The path may instead come from RIDU_SQLITE_PATH. Status reports the reversed artifact as pending so migrate up can replay it.

cli:ridu#ridu migrate reset.summary: Reverse every applied SQLite artifact in exact reverse order.
details: SQLite only. The path may instead come from RIDU_SQLITE_PATH. Artifact files and checksums remain committed; schema, callbacks, and ledger changes roll back atomically.

cli:ridu#ridu migrate refresh.summary: Reverse and replay complete committed SQLite history atomically.
details: SQLite only. The path may instead come from RIDU_SQLITE_PATH. Registered compiled down and up callbacks run with their checksum-bound artifacts in the same transaction.

cli:ridu#ridu migrate fresh.summary: Drop non-internal SQLite objects and replay committed history atomically.
details: SQLite only. The path may instead come from RIDU_SQLITE_PATH. Use this explicit destructive workflow for a reviewed local rebuild, not as production startup synchronization.

cli:ridu#PostgreSQL migration runner opt.summary: PostgreSQL operational admissions and bounds accepted by migrate up and, except stop boundaries, verify.
details: --allow-maintenance requires every application process and worker to remain stopped through completion and retries.
Zero durations select bounded defaults unless --allow-unbounded is explicit.
--stop-after-phase and --stop-after-step are accepted only by PostgreSQL migrate up; verify always runs to completion.

cli:ridu#MongoDB migration runner option.summary: MongoDB operational admissions and bounds accepted by migrate up and verify.
details: --allow-maintenance requires every application process and worker to remain stopped through completion and retries.

--advisory-lock-wait bounds acquisition of the fenced migration lease; --concurrent-index-timeout bounds the complete MongoDB migration operation. Zero selects bounded defaults unless --allow-unbounded is explicit, and lease expiry remains bounded.

MongoDB rejects the PostgreSQL-only --lock-timeout, --statement-timeout, --batch-timeout, --idle-in-transaction-timeout, --stop-after-phase, and --stop-after-step controls. Interrupted work resumes from the checksum-bound durable step ledger.

cli:ridu#ridu plugin new.summary: Scaffold paired Go and Svelte plugin packages with conformance tests.
details: The key must be stable and lowercase. Publish the Go and admin packages with matching plugin pairing versions after both conformance suites pass.

cli:ridu#ridu plugin add.summary: Install and register a compiled backend plugin and optional paired admin package.

parameters.name: --go-version
parameters.description: Go module requirement; defaults to latest.

parameters.name: --constructor
parameters.description: Exported zero-argument constructor; defaults to New.

parameters.name: --admin-version
parameters.description: Admin package requirement; defaults to latest.

parameters.name: --no-install
parameters.description: Update registration without invoking Go or the configured frontend package manager.

details: ridu add is an exact alias. The command updates dependencies and registration, regenerates contracts, checks compatibility, and rolls back its files on failure. Review the descriptor and create a migration afterward.

cli:ridu#ridu plugin remove.summary: Remove static plugin registration and dependencies, then regenerate contracts.
details: Without --no-install the command removes the Bun dependency and runs go mod tidy. It rolls back on generation failure. Create a migration to review any plugin down steps.

cli:ridu#ridu help.summary: Show commands and the compiled project-protocol and schema-manifest versions.

ts:@riducms/plugin/admin#defineAdmin.summary: Configure the custom components, installed plugins, and translations used by your application’s admin.

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: Required configuration object. Every property inside it is optional; choose the parts of the admin you want to customize below.

details: Use this function once in admin/src/admin.config.ts. Keep plugins: `generatedAdminPlugins` when adding your own settings so installed plugins continue to load.
The fields map contains application inputs made with `defineFieldEditor`. It is different from `defineAdminPlugin`’s fields map, which contains editors for new Go plugin field types.
Installed plugins are processed first, followed by application entries. Keys must be unique, and conflicting replacements cause an error rather than silently replacing one another.
The helper checks JavaScript registrations immediately. Run ridu check to also compare them with the Go schema, including component selections, supported field types, routes, and settings.
The example adds WelcomePanel above the dashboard. The Custom components tutorial includes the Svelte component and shows how to try it.

returns.description: The same `AdminConfig` object after checking its registrations. Export it as the default from admin/src/admin.config.ts; calling `defineAdmin` does not render components or send requests.

options.name: plugins
options.description: Optional. Installed admin packages. Keep `generatedAdminPlugins` here so plugins installed through the CLI, such as rich text, are loaded.

options.name: fields
options.description: Optional. Custom inputs made with `defineFieldEditor`. Register under app:name, then select that name in the Go field’s `Admin.Editor` setting.

options.name: rowLabels
options.description: Optional. Array and block headings made with `defineRowLabel`. Select their app:name keys through `Admin.RowLabel` in Go.

options.name: messages
options.description: Optional. Application interface messages made with `defineAdminMessages`; use app:messageName to translate them.

options.name: languages
options.description: Optional. Bundled translations for the admin interface. These are separate from the locales used for document content.

options.name: routes
options.description: Optional. Add pages inside the admin, each with a relative path, component, and optional navigation link. Plugin routes must also appear in the Go descriptor.

options.name: dashboard
options.description: Optional. Add panels before or after the dashboard, or replace it. Each entry names a key, component, and position; the default position is after.

options.name: listCells

ts:@riducms/plugin/authoring/v1#definePl.summary: Connect a new Go field type to its default Svelte editor and the functions that check its values.

parameters.name: definition
parameters.type: FieldDefinition<Value, Config, "plugin", Input> & { decodeConfig: (value: unknown) => Config; decodeInput: (value: unknown) => Input; }
parameters.description: Required object containing component and `decodeValue`. Add `decodeInput` for a different write shape, or `decodeConfig` for editor settings.

details: Use this for a new type such as color.Field("accent"). The fields map key must match `PluginFieldType.Key` in the Go descriptor. Do not put app: on that key; app:name belongs to application field editors.

For a character counter or another input on an existing text, number, or checkbox field in one application, use `defineFieldEditor`. For a named alternative supplied by a plugin, use `defineFieldComponent`.

`Value` describes data returned by the server. `Input` describes data sent back and defaults to `Value`. `Config` is inferred from `decodeConfig`. TypeScript usually infers these from the decoder functions; explicit generic arguments are unnecessary.

When reading an unsaved form value, Ridu tries `decodeValue` first and then `decodeInput` if a separate input decoder is present. `field.value` may therefore contain either saved data or a pending edit.

Keep decoders synchronous and free of side effects. They may run on every read. Throw an Error with a useful message for unsupported data; `field.rawValue` remains available when a plugin needs to display or recover it.
Browser decoding does not replace the Go validator. `field.set(...)` changes the unsaved form; the document Save action sends it to the server for validation.
The example is the color plugin’s admin entry. Follow Build a field plugin for its complete Svelte editor, value decoder, and Go implementation.

returns.description: A frozen `PluginFieldRegistration` with type: "plugin", retaining inferred saved-value and input types. Put it under the Go field-type key in `defineAdminPlugin`({ fields: ... }). The helper does not create a Go field or register server validation.

options.name: component
options.description: Required. The Svelte editor. It reads `field.value`, writes unsaved changes with `field.set(...)`, and receives config only when `decodeConfig` is supplied.

options.name: decodeValue
options.description: Required. Check a saved value and return the value type the component can read. Throw an Error for invalid data. Runs synchronously; Ridu handles null and undefined separately.

options.name: decodeInput
options.description: Optional. Check values passed to `field.set` when the server accepts a different shape from saved data. Defaults to `decodeValue` when omitted. It must return synchronously.

options.name: decodeConfig
options.description: Optional. Check Go field settings and return the component’s config prop. Without this decoder, the plugin’s field settings must be empty and the component receives no config prop.

parameters.name: definition
parameters.type: { type: Type & SingleType<NoInfer<Type>>; } & NamedFieldTarget<Type, Key> & FieldDefinition<Value, Config, Type, Input> & { decodeConfig: (value: unknown) => Config; decodeInput: (value: unknown) => Input; }

The components map key is a JavaScript component name such as colorSwatch. Select it in Go with `field.PluginComponent("editorial-tools", "colorSwatch")` in the field’s `Admin.Editor` setting.

The Go field keeps its existing storage, validation, permissions, and generated types. type must match that field. For text-like fields, values remain strings; number and checkbox fields use numbers and booleans.

`decodeValue` checks saved data. `decodeInput` defaults to it and is needed only for a different write shape. All decoders are synchronous; server validation still runs when the document is saved.

options.description: Required. The Svelte editor with props for the selected field and decoded value/config types.

options.description: Required. Check a saved value and return the value type the component can read. Throw an Error for invalid data. Runs synchronously; Ridu handles null and undefined separately.

options.name: decodeInput
options.description: Optional. Check values passed to `field.set` when the server accepts a different shape from saved data. Defaults to `decodeValue` when omitted. It must return synchronously.

options.name: decodeConfig

parameters.name: ctx

returns.description: Return Present(value), nil to supply a value; Empty[T](), nil to leave the field without a default; or an error to stop the operation. Present accepts zero, false, an empty string, or an empty list. Every supplied value must still pass the field’s validation.

details: Pass this callback to a field’s DefaultFrom method. T is string for Text, Textarea, Code, Email, Date, Select, and Radio; float64 for Number; bool for Checkbox; []string for MultiSelect and TextList; and []float64 for NumberList.

Ridu calls it for omitted fields when initializing new content, including children in a new object or row during an update. Explicit input, including null and empty values, does not run the callback. An ordinary edit does not refill an existing field.

Raw BeforeValidate hooks run before default initialization. A raw hook that supplies a value prevents the default from running. Later validation still checks required values, declared choices, and other field rules. Returning Empty does not satisfy Required.
Dynamic defaults are evaluated when saving on the server; they do not prefill an unsaved admin form. Config resolution, code generation, and admin builds do not call the function.
Read values already available in ctx; do not depend on another dynamic default running first. Keep the callback free of irreversible side effects because another request or a retry can call it again.

parameters.description: The document action, such as Create or Duplicate. It can be Update when an edit adds a new object, row, or translation; a default callback does not imply a new document.

parameters.name: Actor
parameters.description: The signed-in document, its auth collection, and a snapshot of its fields. Actor.ID is empty for an anonymous request; Actor is a value, not a pointer.

parameters.name: Locale
parameters.description: The exact content locale being initialized, or an empty string without localization. Locale fallback is not treated as stored input.

parameters.name: Root

parameters.name: Siblings
parameters.description: Fields in the same enclosing object or row. For seo.title, this is seo; for a title at the document root, this is Root. It has the same timing limits as Root.

parameters.name: Prior
parameters.description: Previously saved fields in the same enclosing object or row, matched by stable row key. Empty for a new nested object, row, or translation. During duplication the root can contain source values, while copied rows with new keys have no prior row.

parameters.name: Local
parameters.description: Read a known document with FindByID. Reads enforce this actor’s access rules, use the exact locale without fallback, and share the active transaction and cancellation. This reader cannot write documents.

parameters.name: ID
parameters.description: The document identifier. It may still be empty before a newly created document receives an ID.

parameters.name: CollectionID
parameters.description: The collection’s framework identifier, not its authored slug. Empty for a global.

parameters.name: GlobalID
parameters.description: The global’s framework identifier, not its authored slug. Empty for a collection.

parameters.name: AllLocales
parameters.description: Whether Root retains locale-keyed values. A visit to one exact localized value receives false.

parameters.name: OccurrenceID

go:github.com/riducms/ridu/field#LiveVal.summary: Check an unsaved field value on the server and return feedback before the author saves.

parameters.name: ctx
parameters.description: The request, user, exact locale, readable form values, saved values, and a read-only document reader.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The current typed value after retaining omitted update fields. Get returns the value and whether it is present. Missing and null values are empty; use ctx.Input.Lookup to distinguish omitted input from an explicit null.

returns.description: Return nil, nil when the check finds no problem; issues, nil for messages the author can act on; or an error when the check could not run. An error fails the feedback request. An issue with no Target belongs to the current field.

details: Register this callback with LiveValidate. Register save rules separately with Validate: live feedback does not run during Save and cannot guarantee that a later save will succeed.

T matches the field’s write type: string for text-like fields and single choices; float64 for Number; bool for Checkbox; []string for MultiSelect; operation.ID or []operation.ID for relationships and uploads; store.Value for structured and plugin fields.

Ridu skips a callback when the field value cannot be decoded to its expected type. Missing or null input can still reach a callback as an empty operation.Value. Structured store.Value callbacks must check child values themselves; defaults, save hooks, and full validation have not run.
Keep the check repeatable and free of writes or other side effects. Pass ctx.Context to cancellable work and ctx.Local.FindByID; the request has a five-second deadline.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu/operation#Liv.summary: The request and surrounding values available to a live server validation callback.

parameters.name: Context
parameters.description: Cancellation and deadline for this feedback request. Pass ctx.Context to reads and other cancellable work; replacing it cannot remove the original cancellation.

parameters.name: Operation
parameters.description: Create for a new collection document; Update for an existing document or any global, including its first save.

parameters.name: CollectionID
parameters.description: The collection’s framework identifier, not its slug or document ID. Empty for a global.

parameters.name: GlobalID
parameters.description: The global’s framework identifier, not its slug. Empty for a collection.

parameters.name: ID
parameters.description: The saved document ID. Empty for a new collection document.

parameters.name: Actor
parameters.description: The authenticated document, its auth collection, and a snapshot of its fields. Actor.ID is empty for an anonymous request.

parameters.name: Locale
parameters.description: The exact content locale being checked, or empty without localization. Saved and submitted values never include locale fallback; all-locales requests are unsupported.

parameters.name: Root
parameters.description: Readable unsaved document values, retaining omitted update fields from storage. In a detached embedded editor, this is the parent document before Apply; the detached payload is in Siblings.

parameters.name: Siblings
parameters.description: Readable values in the current enclosing object or row, including retained update fields. For seo.title, this is seo. No defaults or save hooks have run.

parameters.name: Prior
parameters.description: Readable saved values for this enclosing object or row in the exact locale. Rows match by stable key and block type, never by index. Empty for a new object, row, embedded item, or translation.

parameters.name: Input
parameters.description: Submitted values in this enclosing object before retaining omitted update fields. Lookup distinguishes an omitted property from one explicitly set to null. The separate value argument contains the value after retention.

parameters.name: Local
parameters.description: Read a known document with FindByID, enforcing this user’s access rules in the same read-only transaction and exact locale. Reads run no lifecycle hooks, defaults, or computed outputs. This reader cannot write.

details: Ridu supplies this context to field.LiveValidator callbacks. Its values are snapshots of an unfinished form. They have not passed save transforms or full field validation.
View.Get, View.String, and View.Lookup read one direct child name. To read seo.title, first read the seo object; a dotted string does not traverse a View.
Use Input to ask what the request submitted, Siblings to check the current object, and Prior to compare it with saved data. Readability rules can hide values from all these views.

ts:@riducms/plugin#FieldLiveValidation.summary: Read live server feedback status and retry a failed check from a custom field component.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Read-only state for the current field. See the status descriptions below.

parameters.name: retry
parameters.description: Request another check with the current form values after a failure. Returns immediately; follow status for the result. Ridu owns requests and cancellation.

details: Read this through field.liveValidation. Validation messages are in field.issues; this object reports whether the check ran.
idle: no live check is active for this field, for example before editing or after the form resets.
pending: a check is scheduled or in progress.
checked: the server evaluated the live check. Read field.issues for any messages; checked does not mean the value passed or that Save will succeed.
skipped: the current input could not be checked, for example because its value or enclosing row could not be decoded. It is not a successful validation result.
failed: the feedback request could not complete. Show a retry control and call retry(); this is separate from an issue returned for invalid content.

ts:@riducms/plugin/editor#FieldBinding.summary: Read and update one field in the unsaved form, including validation messages and live feedback.

parameters.name: liveValidation
parameters.description: Read the check’s status or call retry() after a failure. Ridu runs the requests; messages appear alongside other validation issues in field.issues.

details: Ridu creates and cleans up this field connection. For arrays and blocks, it follows the row’s stable _key through reorder. Removing the field or replacing the form makes the connection stale; use the binding supplied to the newly mounted editor.

ts:@riducms/plugin#PluginFieldBinding.summary: Read and update one field in the unsaved form, including validation messages and live feedback.

parameters.name: liveValidation
parameters.description: Read the check’s status or call retry() after a failure. Ridu runs the requests; messages appear alongside other validation issues in field.issues.

details: Ridu creates and cleans up this field connection. For arrays and blocks, it follows the row’s stable _key through reorder. Removing the field or replacing the form makes the connection stale; use the binding supplied to the newly mounted editor.

ts:@riducms/sdk#LiveValidationOptions.summary: Choose the exact content locale and cancellation signal for a live validation request.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Optional. Check one configured content locale; omission uses the default locale. "all" and locale fallback are not supported.

parameters.name: signal
parameters.description: Optional. Cancel a request when input changes, the form closes, or a newer check replaces it.

parameters.name: headers
parameters.description: Optional. Additional headers for this request, using the SDK’s normal request behavior.

parameters.name: keepalive
parameters.description: Optional. Forward the Fetch keepalive option. Live form checks normally use cancellation instead of continuing after navigation.

ts:@riducms/sdk#RiduClient.collectionLiv.summary: Check unsaved collection fields on the server without saving them.

parameters.name: collection
parameters.description: The collection slug from your Go configuration.

parameters.name: input
parameters.description: The unsaved data and field paths to check. Omit id for a new document; include the saved document ID to check an update.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Optional. Exact locale, cancellation signal, and normal request options.

returns.description: Resolves with evaluations for the requested fields. Each is checked with zero or more issues, or skipped with no issues. Invalid content is returned as feedback, while failed requests reject with the SDK’s normal errors. A checked response does not guarantee a later save.

details: Runs only callbacks registered with LiveValidate. It does not save data, run defaults or save hooks, or invoke Validate callbacks.
The caller must pass admin access, read access, and the relevant create or update access rules. The server only checks fields the caller can read and edit.
Send the current form values, cancel superseded requests, and discard results from an older form state. Built-in admin forms handle this automatically.

ts:@riducms/sdk#RiduClient.globalLiveVal.summary: Check unsaved global fields on the server without saving them.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The global slug from your Go configuration.

parameters.name: input
parameters.description: The unsaved data and field paths to check. Do not supply a document ID; globals always use update rules.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Optional. Exact locale, cancellation signal, and normal request options.

returns.description: Resolves with evaluations for the requested fields. Each is checked with zero or more issues, or skipped with no issues. Invalid content is returned as feedback, while failed requests reject with the SDK’s normal errors. A checked response does not guarantee a later save.

details: Runs only callbacks registered with LiveValidate. It does not save data, run defaults or save hooks, or invoke Validate callbacks.
The caller must pass admin access, read access, and the relevant create or update access rules. The server only checks fields the caller can read and edit.
Send the current form values, cancel superseded requests, and discard results from an older form state. Built-in admin forms handle this automatically.

ts:@riducms/protocol#LiveValidationReque.summary: The unsaved form values and field paths sent for live server validation.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Optional for collections. Include a saved document ID to check an update; omit it for a new document. Global requests must not include id.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Required. Unsaved document values. On updates, omitted fields retain their saved values; explicit null clears a value for the check. No defaults or save hooks are applied.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Required. Between 1 and 64 distinct document-root paths, such as "salePrice" or "variants.0.salePrice". Use the current row index in a repeated path; each requested field must have a live validator.

parameters.name: embedded
parameters.description: Optional. Up to eight detached embedded editor payloads, selected through Go-declared plugin metadata. The built-in admin supplies these for embedded forms.

details: The REST request body is limited to 1 MiB. Requests evaluate one exact locale, selected through LiveValidationOptions. The server limits checks to five seconds.

ts:@riducms/protocol#LiveValidationEvalu.summary: The result of checking one requested field’s unsaved value.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The requested document-root field path, such as "variants.0.salePrice".

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Optional opaque field identity supplied by the server for correlating feedback. Do not construct or parse it.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: checked means the callbacks ran; issues may still contain validation messages. skipped means the value or target could not be checked and issues is empty.

parameters.name: issues
parameters.description: Validation messages from this live check. An empty list means no messages were returned; it is not a guarantee that saving will succeed.

details: Messages can target the field or its children. Keep live feedback separate from save failures and discard feedback when its form state is no longer current.

ts:@riducms/protocol#LiveValidationEnvel.summary: Live validation results returned by the collection and global SDK methods.

parameters.name: evaluations
parameters.description: One result for each requested field path, with its checked or skipped status and validation messages.

details: A successful response can contain validation issues. Request failures reject the SDK call instead of returning a checked result.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu/field#NumberL.summary: Add a field containing an ordered list of numbers.

returns.description: A NumberListField definition. Call its methods to set item limits, list length, defaults, or callbacks.

details: Order and duplicates are preserved. Items must be finite numbers; numeric strings are rejected. Min and Max apply to each number, including both bounds.
Required requires at least one item. MinRows and MaxRows count items; they do not limit each item’s value. An explicit empty list remains an empty array.
Validators and hooks receive the complete []float64 value. Use Array for items with child fields, or MultiSelect for choices from a predefined set.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu/field#TextLis.summary: Add a field containing an ordered list of text values.

returns.description: A TextListField definition. Call its methods to set item limits, list length, defaults, or callbacks.

details: Order and duplicates are preserved. Strings are not trimmed. MinLength and MaxLength apply to each string, counting Unicode code points.
Required requires at least one item. MinRows and MaxRows count items; they do not limit each item’s value. An explicit empty list remains an empty array.
Validators and hooks receive the complete []string value. Use Array for items with child fields, or MultiSelect for choices from a predefined set.

details: Use ReplaceLiveValidators to replace the field’s checks.
Create it with field.TextList(name). Setters return a new definition, leaving the original unchanged.
List-length limits use MinRows and MaxRows. Text-length limits apply to each string.
Callbacks operate on the whole []string list. Items have no child field definitions or saved row keys.

parameters.name: values
parameters.description: Omit the argument or pass true to require at least one item; pass false to make the field optional.

returns.description: The updated TextListField; the original field is unchanged.

details: Missing, null, and [] fail when required. A positive MinRows also requires items, even with Required(false).
Use MinLength(1) as well to reject empty strings inside the list.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu/field#TextLis.summary: Set the minimum number of items.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Minimum item count, zero or greater. Zero adds no minimum.

returns.description: The updated TextListField; the original field is unchanged.

details: A positive minimum also rejects omitted, null, and empty values. This counts list items, not characters or numeric magnitude.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu/field#TextLis.summary: Set the maximum number of items.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Maximum item count, zero or greater. Zero means no configured maximum.

returns.description: The updated TextListField; the original field is unchanged.

details: The maximum must not be below MinRows. The admin disables Add item when this limit is reached.

parameters.name: values
parameters.description: Initial items, in order. With no arguments, the default is an empty list.

returns.description: The updated TextListField; the original field is unchanged.

details: Items are copied and must satisfy item and count constraints. This replaces any DefaultFrom callback.
Defaults fill eligible omissions; explicit null and [] are not replaced.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu/field#TextLis.summary: Calculate the initial list on the server.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: A callback receiving operation.DefaultContext and returning operation.Value[[]string] and an error.

returns.description: The updated TextListField; the original field is unchanged.

details: Return operation.Present(values) to supply the list or operation.Empty[[]string]() to supply no default. A returned error stops the save.
This replaces a literal default. Returned items must satisfy normal item, count, and custom validation rules.

returns.description: The configured default callback, or nil; it is not executed.

details: Returns nil when no dynamic default is configured. Reading the callback does not execute it.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu/field#TextLis.summary: Add a rule for the whole list when saving.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: A callback receiving operation.ValidationContext and operation.Value[[]string], returning ([]operation.Issue, error).

returns.description: The updated TextListField; the original field is unchanged.

details: The callback runs once for the whole list. It appends to existing save validators.
Return issues on the list field; items have no individual issue targets. Return nil, nil to accept the value, or an error when the check cannot complete.
For feedback while editing, register a separate LiveValidate callback too.

parameters.name: values
parameters.description: The replacement callbacks; omit all arguments to remove custom save validators.

returns.description: The updated TextListField; the original field is unchanged.

details: Built-in item/count limits and live validators remain in place. Each callback receives the whole []string list.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu/field#TextLis.summary: Set lifecycle hooks for the whole list.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: A field.Hooks[[]string] value containing the hooks to run.

returns.description: The updated TextListField; the original field is unchanged.

details: Replaces previously configured write/event hooks. BeforeChange receives the whole typed list and may return a replacement. Raw hooks still receive store.Value.
Use AppendHooks or PrependHooks to keep existing hooks.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu/field#TextLis.summary: Set hooks that shape the returned list.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: A field.ReadHooks[[]string] value containing read hooks.

returns.description: The updated TextListField; the original field is unchanged.

details: Replaces configured read hooks. AfterRead can change the returned list without rewriting stored values.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu/field#TextLis.summary: Set the minimum length of each string.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Minimum number of Unicode code points per item, zero or greater.

returns.description: The updated TextListField; the original field is unchanged.

details: This does not require the list itself to contain items. Add Required or MinRows for that. Whitespace is preserved.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu/field#TextLis.summary: Set the maximum length of each string.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Maximum number of Unicode code points per item, zero or greater.

returns.description: The updated TextListField; the original field is unchanged.

details: Zero permits only empty strings. The limit must be at least MinLength. Use MaxRows to limit the number of items.
Create it with field.NumberList(name). Setters return a new definition, leaving the original unchanged.
List-length limits use MinRows and MaxRows. Numeric bounds apply to each number.
Callbacks operate on the whole []float64 list. Items have no child field definitions or saved row keys.

parameters.name: values
parameters.description: Omit the argument or pass true to require at least one item; pass false to make the field optional.

returns.description: The updated NumberListField; the original field is unchanged.

details: Missing, null, and [] fail when required. A positive MinRows also requires items, even with Required(false).

go:github.com/riducms/ridu/field#NumberL.summary: Set the minimum number of items.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Minimum item count, zero or greater. Zero adds no minimum.

returns.description: The updated NumberListField; the original field is unchanged.

details: A positive minimum also rejects omitted, null, and empty values. This counts list items, not characters or numeric magnitude.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu/field#NumberL.summary: Set the maximum number of items.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Maximum item count, zero or greater. Zero means no configured maximum.

returns.description: The updated NumberListField; the original field is unchanged.

details: The maximum must not be below MinRows. The admin disables Add item when this limit is reached.

parameters.name: values
parameters.description: Initial items, in order. With no arguments, the default is an empty list.

returns.description: The updated NumberListField; the original field is unchanged.

details: Items are copied and must satisfy item and count constraints. This replaces any DefaultFrom callback.
Defaults fill eligible omissions; explicit null and [] are not replaced.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu/field#NumberL.summary: Calculate the initial list on the server.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: A callback receiving operation.DefaultContext and returning operation.Value[[]float64] and an error.

returns.description: The updated NumberListField; the original field is unchanged.

details: Return operation.Present(values) to supply the list or operation.Empty[[]float64]() to supply no default. A returned error stops the save.
This replaces a literal default. Returned items must satisfy normal item, count, and custom validation rules.

returns.description: The configured default callback, or nil; it is not executed.

details: Returns nil when no dynamic default is configured. Reading the callback does not execute it.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu/field#NumberL.summary: Add a rule for the whole list when saving.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: A callback receiving operation.ValidationContext and operation.Value[[]float64], returning ([]operation.Issue, error).

returns.description: The updated NumberListField; the original field is unchanged.

details: The callback runs once for the whole list. It appends to existing save validators.
Return issues on the list field; items have no individual issue targets. Return nil, nil to accept the value, or an error when the check cannot complete.
For feedback while editing, register a separate LiveValidate callback too.

parameters.name: values
parameters.description: The replacement callbacks; omit all arguments to remove custom save validators.

returns.description: The updated NumberListField; the original field is unchanged.

details: Built-in item/count limits and live validators remain in place. Each callback receives the whole []float64 list.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu/field#NumberL.summary: Set lifecycle hooks for the whole list.

returns.description: The updated NumberListField; the original field is unchanged.

Use AppendHooks or PrependHooks to keep existing hooks.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu/field#NumberL.summary: Set hooks that shape the returned list.

parameters.name: value

returns.description: The updated NumberListField; the original field is unchanged.

details: Replaces configured read hooks. AfterRead can change the returned list without rewriting stored values.

go:github.com/riducms/ridu/field#NumberL.summary: Set the maximum value of each number.

parameters.name: value
